candidate_relations.reason: The reference requires two distinct components: (1) WDR19-related NPHP13 (Nephronophthisis 13) as the specific ciliopathy subtype, and (2) Caroli disease as the hepatobiliary complication evidenced by intrahepatic bile duct dilatation on MRI. C001 captures the WDR19 gene association and renal involvement but does not specify NPHP13 and entirely omits Caroli disease, making it an incomplete parent-level descriptor.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the WDR19 gene and renal involvement but omits the specific NPHP13 subtype designation and the Caroli disease component

case_quality_flags: Compound heterozygous WDR19 variants confirm NPHP13; intrahepatic bile duct dilatation on MRI supports Caroli disease component
TG gene variants suggest concurrent congenital hypothyroidism but are not part of the reference diagnosis
